## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf` — performance improvement
- [ ] `test` — adding or correcting tests
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — build process, tooling, or dependency update
- [ ] `ci` — CI/CD pipeline change

- [ ] Coverage stays at or above 80%
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes (0 warnings)

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow `type: description` convention (enforced by commitlint)
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets or credentials
- [ ] All user inputs validated
- [ ] Breaking changes documented in commit body with `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer
